title: Zariski sheaf cohomology
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on its small Zariski site $X_{\rm Zar}$ [def-sc-zariski-site]. Let $\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ be the category of such sheaves; it is an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives] (applied to the site $X_{\rm Zar}$), and the global-sections functor $\Gamma(X,-):\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})\to\operatorname{Ab}$, $F\mapsto F(X)$, is additive and left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive], [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2) (for the object $X$ of $X_{\rm Zar}$). Define $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},F)$, $q\ge0$, to be the $q$-th right derived functor $R^q\Gamma(X,-)(F)$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive]; that is, by that definition, for an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] $F\to I^\bullet$ in $\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$, $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},F)=H^q(\Gamma(X,I^\bullet))$, independent of the resolution up to canonical isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2).
